name: Calendar Watchlist
description: Human-curated calendars and recurring feeds Puddles checks for ages 0–5 activities. Distinct from Discovery library scrapers (BiblioCommons / LibCal) and from the live Events catalog.

sources.name: Mountain View Special Events
sources.org: City of Mountain View · Community Services
sources.notes: Summer Music on Castro, Concerts on the Plaza, outdoor movies, festivals. Family-friendly all-ages; not toddler-specific. Site often blocks automated fetch (Akamai) — keep manual. Known child pages: harvest-history-festival (on Puddles as Harvest History Festival, Sep 26 2026, calendar Event/3482).

sources.name: Los Altos Family Fun Days
sources.org: City of Los Altos · Community Services
sources.notes: Free themed Saturdays 10am–1pm at Community Center with library partners. Aug 8 Pirate Palooza, Oct 24 Halloween Hoopla, Dec 12 Winter Wonderland — already Published.

sources.name: Downtown Los Altos Events
sources.notes: Most listings are adult. A BOO-tiful Downtown Halloween (Oct 30, ~12–4) is in Discovery.

sources.name: CSMA Concerts
sources.org: Community School of Music and Arts
sources.notes: Evening concert series (jazz/classical) — not ages 0–5. Prefer CSMA family days / Community Arts Day style programs when posted elsewhere on arts4all.org.

sources.name: Linden Tree Books
sources.notes: Weekly Outdoor Storytime + author picture-book storytimes in Discovery. Skip YA/MG launches and 9+ book clubs.

sources.name: Home Depot Kids Workshop
sources.notes: Monthly free build workshops — Ages 2–5. Sep 5 + Oct 3 already Published.

sources.name: Oshman Family JCC · Jeff Center for Families
sources.notes: Free Family Play weekdays (Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30–5:30; Tue/Thu 1–5:30; check holiday/special hours). Doodle & Discover Wednesdays (free crafts ages 2–6). Skip Blossom paid prenatal/CPR for Browse.

sources.name: Peninsula Youth Theatre · Stories on Stage
sources.notes: Picture-book stage shows at MVCPA SecondStage. Creepy Carrots Oct 10 (11:30 & 1:30) in Discovery — Paid.

sources.name: Elizabeth F. Gamble Garden
sources.notes: Halloween Magic Oct 24 (Paid tickets, outdoors) in Discovery. Skip adult-leaning Halloween Tea.
